items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He and Eddie, Alan Greta, Joe Phillips, the bass player, who we had on get ourselves. ... [INTERVIEWEE] So we kept it going.

ctx.x: Couldn't take much. What was that?
He and Eddie, Alan Greta, Joe Phillips, the bass player, who we had on get ourselves.
